description: Transitive authority amplification: P→A(L2)→B(L2)→C where C holds L3 standing privileges. NOTE: Annam's matrix marks AV-02 as INV-01 + INV-02 — the INV-02 provenance dimension (end-to-end lineage detection) is a supporting invariant, not encoded in the single-valued invariant field (INV-01 primary).
